description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different models on the BBQ dataset as a function of the number of training steps, with the x-axis representing the number of steps ranging from 0 to 1500 in increments of 250, and the y-axis showing accuracy values from 45 to 55. The plot includes four models: Squared Exponential, T5, ELL, and LLAMA-2-chat-7B, each represented by a distinct line style and color. The Squared Exponential model, shown in dark blue with a solid line, starts at an accuracy of approximately 52.5 and increases to around 56.5 by 1500 steps, showing a steady upward trend. The T5 model, represented by a light blue dashed line, begins at about 49.5 and remains relatively stable, ending slightly above 49.5. The ELL model, depicted with a light purple dotted line, starts at approximately 47.5 and stays nearly flat, ending just above 47.5. The LLAMA-2-chat-7B model, shown with a pink dash-dotted line, begins at around 47.5 and remains constant throughout the training steps. The legend is positioned in the upper right corner, and a horizontal pink dashed line at y=47.5 is labeled "LLaMA-2-chat-7B," indicating a baseline or reference value.
